https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Taylor_Swift_at_the_2023_MTV_Video_Music_Awards_(1).pngAmerican singer-songwriter [Taylor Swift](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor_Swift) is the most-streamed artist in Spotify's history.

The following list contains the most-streamed artists on the [audio streaming](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Streaming_media) platform [Spotify](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spotify). As of April 2026, [Taylor Swift](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor_Swift) is the most-streamed artist in Spotify's history. [Bad Bunny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bad_Bunny) is the most-streamed male artist.[[1]](#cite_note-Millman-2026-1)

Since 2013, Spotify has published a yearly list of its most-streamed artists, which has been topped by Bad Bunny a record four times (2020–2022; 2025), being the only artist to do so in three consecutive years. [Drake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drake_(musician)) has topped the list three times (2015–2016; 2018), while Swift is the only female artist to have topped the list (2023–2024).

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Taylor_Swift_at_the_2023_MTV_Video_Music_Awards_(1).pngAmerican singer-songwriter [Taylor Swift](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor_Swift) is the most-streamed artist in Spotify's history.

The following list contains the most-streamed artists on the [audio streaming](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Streaming_media) platform [Spotify](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spotify). As of April 2026, [Taylor Swift](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor_Swift) is the most-streamed artist in Spotify's history. [Bad Bunny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bad_Bunny) is the most-streamed male artist.[[1]](#cite_note-Millman-2026-1)

Since 2013, Spotify has published a yearly list of its most-streamed artists, which has been topped by Bad Bunny a record four times (2020–2022; 2025), being the only artist to do so in three consecutive years. [Drake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drake_(musician)) has topped the list three times (2015–2016; 2018), while Swift is the only female artist to have topped the list (2023–2024).
